name: MetaMCP
summary: Docker-packaged MCP proxy that aggregates MCP servers into namespaces exposed as one MCP endpoint, with middleware, tool overrides and an inspector.
description: MetaMCP is itself an MCP server, so any MCP client can use it. The README notes maintenance delays: development moved to an `ai-dev` branch, and a community fork is maintained at Umbrella-IT-Group/metamcp. Last tagged release v2.4.22 (2025-12-19).
